ornament_set.notes: First-listed ornament (Cyrene.ts:496): Bone Collection's Serene Demesne (+12% Max HP; +28% CRIT DMG at 5000 Max HP or more, wearer and memosprite). Amphoreus (+8% SPD to allies with a memosprite) is also in Fribbels' list and would add 8% of base (about 8); not used because Bone Collection is first-listed.

main_stats.notes: Fribbels options: Body CRIT Rate/CRIT DMG/HP%, Feet HP%/SPD, Sphere HP%/Ice DMG, Rope HP%. Feet SPD because of the 180 target. GUESS: Body CRIT Rate (proxy +4.5% over HP% body, +4.7% over CRIT DMG body). Sphere Ice DMG (proxy +14.7% over HP%). Rope HP% only.

distributed.notes: Fribbels substat list: CRIT DMG, CRIT Rate, HP%, HP, SPD. SPD: 10 distributed, the cap (SPD boots leave 5 relics without an SPD main stat, 2 each). 101 base + 9 (trace) + 25.032 + 4.6 + 23.0 = 162.63. The 180 breakpoint is out of reach by about 17 SPD (8 more rolls than the cap allows); Fribbels judges it on in-combat SPD, which includes teammates' buffs that a per-character file cannot know. Either the cap is relaxed for SPD, or her teammates supply the rest, or the 180 line is not a NouSR requirement: Smitty's call. The other 14 rolls follow the proxy. Rolls chosen with a throwaway proxy script (damage ~ scale stat x (1 + CR x CD) x (1 + DMG%), the 2 fixed rolls per stat, the per-relic cap, simple set and trace stats only, an assumed 635 ATK / 1058 HP light cone), not with Fribbels or the kernel. Treat it as a tie-breaker, not a result. SPD arithmetic ignores light cone and team SPD buffs. The cycle-1 two-turn threshold is 133.34 (20000/150); src/engine/breakpoints.test.ts pins 134 as 2 turns and 133 as 1.
